title: Secondary Market Turnover of Treasury Bonds
despription: Historical By Tenor observations are monthly and historical By Category observations are quarterly through December 2025. Redesigned current Security, Region and Counterparty observations are monthly from January 2026. AOFM publishes updates quarterly with a two-month lag. The package joins historical and current sources on period, group and name, gives current precedence for overlapping keys, rejects duplicate keys, and records SHA-256 provenance for both workbooks.
